text:
Ivy: Heads up — we got 4 reports from onsite yesterday where interviewers in FR/DE locales saw scorecard questions in the wrong order and some mandatory fields cleared. Reported by recruiting at 08:10.

Ramon: Which template? new localized bundle?

Ivy: template id=engage-rubric-2.0 with locale bundles: en, fr, de. Affected candidates: C-9122, C-9128, C-9130.

Suki: I pulled one of the submitted payloads. The submission payload had question ids mismatched to labels, e.g. `q12` answered but label showed `q3` text. Looks like the localization rekey step changed ordering. Snippet: 

```
"answers": [{"question_id":"q12","value":4}, {"question_id":"q3","value":5}]
// UI showed labels in sequence q3, q12
```

Nia: Yikes — that means aggregator will attribute scores to wrong rubric items. Any idea what changed?

Ramon: We shipped an i18n bundle refresh last night (l10n pipeline). The bundler now flattens keys and reassigns numeric suffixes during compile for compressed payloads. That was to reduce payload size but I didn't expect it to change question IDs.

Suki: The client UI uses the compiled bundle question index to render labels but uses server-side canonical question_id to write answers. If compile renumbers indexes but doesn't update canonical ids mapping, order/display vs id will diverge.

Ivy: Short-term: recruiters are blocking panels until we confirm. Can we disable the new bundle in prod and revert to previous compiled assets?

Ramon: Yes, we can roll back the bundle from the CDN to last stable artifact (rev 2026-03-18). That will revert client rendering. I'll do a CDN rollback now and post link.

l10n-bot: Automated note: Reverting bundle engage-rubric-2.0.locale.* to artifact rev:2026-03-18. Propagation ETA: ~8 minutes.

Nia: Good. For submissions already recorded, can we remap answers to correct questions?

Suki: We can, if we have the compile mapping from old->new ids. The bundler writes a source map during compile but we did not persist it to the metadata store. The compiled artifacts in staging include maps but prod maps were pruned.

Ramon: I still have the local compile map on my laptop from the build. I can push it to a secure bucket and we can run a remap job for the affected candidate ids.

Ivy: That would help. Prioritize C-9122/9128/9130 first. Also recruiters want a verification step before telling interviewers to resubmit.

Ramon: Plan: 1) rollback CDN (in progress) 2) upload compile mapping to secure bucket 3) run remap job that rewrites submissions to canonical question_ids and re-run aggregation for the three candidates 4) sanity-check diffs and notify recruiting. I'll own steps 2-3.

Suki: I'll prepare the remap script. It will: read submissions where template=engage-rubric-2.0 and submitted_at > 2026-03-22T00:00Z, apply mapping, write corrected payload to `submissions_corrected` table with audit log. Dry-run first for the three candidates.

Nia: Add a verification query that compares pre/post per-question sums; expect small delta but check for misattributed answers.

ops-bot: Runbook note: for any remap run include: author, mapping artifact sha, dry-run flag, affected candidate ids, and rollback command. Tag @security if mapping contains PII.

Ramon: Uploading mapping now. Dry-run results look promising for the three candidates.

Ivy: Once remap is done and aggregates are updated, we'll inform interviewers and hiring managers. Also add a post-deploy test in CI that loads compiled bundle and verifies question_id stability across locales.

Suki: Agreed. I'll add an integration test that asserts compile(source)->bundle mapping preserves canonical question ids and fails the build if not.

Nia: Long-term: remove numeric-only question ids and prefer stable UUIDs to avoid index renumbering issues. Add it to product backlog.

Recruiting: Thanks for the quick turnaround. Please DM when aggregation shows corrected numbers so we can update candidates.

Ivy: Will do. Closing once remap + reagg complete. :white_check_mark:
